items.answerHr: Media Kit sadržava logotipe, fotografije, factsheetove, korporativne podatke i materijale za medije i partnere. Vizualna galerija prikazuje odobrene slike s alt tekstom, captionom i kreditom.
items.answerEn: The Media Kit contains logos, photos, factsheets, corporate information and materials for media and partners. The Visual Gallery presents approved images with alt text, captions and credits.
